head: 3477d064da8541451840959c419b94146b185053
title: feat: Critical-Path Scheduler v1 (PR #107)
body: Introduce Critical-Path Scheduler v1: parallelize test and review stages on implementation completion bound to an immutable candidate SHA, and evaluate multi-dependency join gates deterministically.

head: 2b9f2177fa15446e8d5fd5bce0d95d82e41342ac
title: feat: Selective Replan v1 (explicit task-targeted fix-loop)
body: Introduce Selective Replan v1: narrow fix-loop invalidations to implementation tasks explicitly targeted by structured gate blockers instead of re-running the entire implementation stage.

head: 7709da70c2c395806f3df8359899d229786ab843
title: feat: Selective Reverification v1 (PR #108)
body: Introduce Selective Reverification v1: allow verifiers to reuse previous passing verification results across candidate revisions when changes are outside the declared impact scope.

head: 034cf32bdfd88a694e1b9a55977ef4046a16e31a
title: feat(context): launch-boundary working context validation (PR #155)
body: Validate source task references and boundaries when compiling and saving working context for task dispatch.

head: 6c7b4a963fbd27336ec20fec820a1cfd34eda5a2
title: feat(controller): process sentinel blocked observations via CAS transitions (PR #118)
body: Consume blocked observations from sentinel events and transition tasks to blocked status using compare-and-set updates.

head: 5cd1e0d7ffebe3c2317ad8215a67b6fc4714049b
title: feat(state_db): read-only database connection for diagnostics (PR #102)
body: Provide isolated read-only SQLite database connections with query_only pragma for shadow evaluations and diagnostics.

head: fb9ea2f31466defc7c480eb9c933e637f016d999
title: feat(router): adaptive agent router canary mode and shadow evaluation (PR #103)
body: Add canary traffic routing and shadow decision recording to evaluate agent performance before full rollout.

head: e76d92cb25d9f0fa99c9bc6940cd0beb84d8e75c
title: fix(outcome): bind outcome_id to task+run and fail-closed unknown facts (PR #100)
body: Bind outcome_id deterministically to task and run to avoid primary key collisions across execution attempts, and fail closed when facts are unknown.

head: b747fbd468a3cc02c3b0b8bc641a9bfdd67e6653
title: feat: Adaptive Router Controlled Rollout per-bucket staged expansion (PR #106)
body: Provide auditable per-bucket rollout controls with safety guard evaluations across adaptive agent routing arms.

head: 6f76cd6f40e2222c4ca78f1dfe3f27ac54a739ff
title: fix(loop): fix-loop dead-stall recovery redelivery budget and invalidation latch (PR #85)
body: Implement fix-loop dead-stall recovery with redelivery backoff and invalidation latches across task invalidations.
